shots.name: k1
shots.prompt: Wide shot inside a small neighbourhood library in soft morning daylight. The librarian, a woman of 55 with short silver hair, a brown cardigan and reading glasses on a cord, stands behind the wooden desk holding a plain, titleless hardcover book. Across the desk Kerem, a young man of 24 with short brown hair, a grey hoodie and a backpack strap on one shoulder, leans in politely. Tall shelves with completely blank book spines behind them, green reading lamp on the desk. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k2
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Close-up of the librarian's hands turning the plain hardcover book so its blank cover faces the viewer, a small blank paper slip tucked in the pages as a bookmark; soft window light on the wooden desk. Shallow depth of field. Vertical composition.

shots.name: k3
shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting. Medium shot across the desk: Kerem holds the book with both hands and asks, eyebrows raised hopefully, a small apologetic smile; the librarian listens with a patient, understanding expression, one hand resting on the desk. Blank spines and warm daylight behind. Vertical composition.

shots.prompt: Use the reference image for the characters and the setting: keep the same faces, hair, clothes, colours and lighting.
